contract: docs/plans/interior-visual-polish.md — compact event, Trust and committee presentation with identical content and functionality.

accessibility.evidence: Single H1, existing heading/link/image semantics and alt text retained. All text comparisons match. Four committee group links resolve, each 44px high; focus outlines retained. Passive profiles/emblems add no focus targets. Existing reduced-motion CSS disables animation/transitions; no new scheduling/interaction code. Native preference and screen-reader certification are not claimed.

responsive.evidence: 16 page/viewport cases check all four surfaces at all four targets. No document overflow; long titles, message copy, names and roles fit. Desktop event facts start about 430px earlier. Tablet archive cards corrected after a long venue-label fit failure. Core members use one six-card desktop row, three tablet/two phone columns.

loading.evidence: Fixed image bounds retained. Initial read-only observations include lazy images not yet decoded; rendered captures show loaded photographs and emblems without changing layout structure.

empty.reason: Styling adds no data source or empty state. Existing populated collections are reviewed; empty collection branches remain unchanged and were not injected.

error.reason: No new request/error UI or data path. Existing image/route failure handling is unchanged; deliberate asset failures were outside this visual pass.

partial.evidence: Actual M Raju advisory card renders MR initials without a portrait while retaining his name/role. Other profiles retain their supplied photographs; no invented asset is used.

success.evidence: Normalised main DOM text matches the prior preview in all 16 cases. Full two messages/four message paragraphs and all 24 committee profiles remain. All four group anchors resolve. No console errors in the reviewed local journeys.

permission.reason: Public content styling only; no uploads, accounts, permission requests or data submission.

renderedEvidence.observation: Natural-case long tournament title beside its photo, with dates/venue/status visible in the first desktop viewport.
Tablet archive cards put images above text, align caption starts and retain complete dates/venues without overflow.
Smaller emblem and horizontal speaker identity card preserve the full message beneath; subsequent profile/initials captures show the two-column cards.
Trust emblem/title and complete intro wrap inside the narrow viewport; framed photograph and story follow without horizontal overflow.
